scope: Execution-only inbox for deliveries already authorized by browser port
invariants: Atomic page validation and overflow rejection
Explicit clear removes content and pagination cursor
remaining: Cooperative or cancellable bounded model/TTS execution
Lease loss and scope rebind matrix
solid_review: Dedicated bounded-buffer responsibility (SRP); no browser/provider or Hub dependency (DIP/ISP). It grants no authority, issues no identities, owns no Hub queue and orchestrates no Workers. Broad legacy Companion composition remains separate SRP debt.

ack_processing_review.scope: Real inbox plus ledger; processing snapshot with later admission and fenced send/resend
invariants: Completion accepts only the contiguous oldest prefix
Ack cursor derives from processed entries, not admission cursor
Fenced reply remains unacknowledged until successful resend
Resend does not run answer generation again
